purpose: Generate pronunciation/listening/story/example MP3 files and embed them into exact audio elements. Popup meaning/IPA/UI behavior is already implemented inside the HTML and must not be changed.
instructions: Generate or obtain one natural English MP3 for each item.ttsText.
Read the MP3 bytes and Base64-encode them without line breaks.
Find item.audioSelector in item.targetHtmlFile and set only its src attribute to data:audio/mpeg;base64,<BASE64_MP3_BYTES>.
Do not change popup text, IPA, Persian meanings, layout, story text, exercises, selectors, IDs or navigation.
Do not add external URLs, fetch(), runtime TTS, CDN, ParsPack or GitHub dependencies.
The final deliverable must remain a single self-contained HTML file.

items.ttsText: She is reading a book now.

Right now, Sara is painting a large blue tree for the school art show. She is working in the art room with her friend Noah. The room is busy, but everyone is enjoying the project. Noah is mixing green paint beside her, and Sara is choosing a softer color for the leaves. Their teacher is carrying clean paper from one table to another. This week, the students are learning how to use watercolors. They are trying new techniques, and they are sharing their brushes. Sara is not painting every minute; sometimes she is watching the light near the window and thinking about the next part of the picture. She knows that good art takes patience. Look! A small drop of blue paint is falling onto the table. Sara is laughing, and Noah is bringing a cloth. They are cleaning the table together. The teacher is not getting angry because accidents happen during creative work. Across the room, two students are drawing a quiet street, while another group is building a paper bridge. The art show is tomorrow evening, so the class is also preparing for a future event. Sara is meeting her parents at the gallery at six. Noah is bringing his little sister, and the teacher is opening the doors for visitors. These are arranged plans, not a guess about the future. Listen! The students are talking about their pictures. Sara is saying that her tree represents a safe place. She is not claiming that it is perfect; she is sharing what it means to her. At the moment, the class is making the final labels, and everyone is feeling proud of the work.

items.meaningShownByHtml: کتاب؛ مجموعه‌ای از نوشته‌ها یا مطالب چاپی/دیجیتال برای مطالعه.
مشغول؛ وقتی فرد درگیر کار یا فعالیت‌های زیادی است.
قهوه؛ نوشیدنی تهیه‌شده از دانهٔ قهوه.
هر؛ برای اشاره به تک‌تک اعضای یک مجموعه یا تکرار منظم.
خانواده؛ گروهی از افراد با رابطهٔ خانوادگی و زندگی مشترک یا پیوند نزدیک.
به مدت؛ طول یک بازهٔ زمانی را مشخص می‌کند، مثل for three years.
دوست؛ فردی که رابطهٔ صمیمی و غیرخانوادگی با او داریم.
خانه؛ محل زندگی و جایی که فرد آن را فضای شخصی و خانوادگی خود می‌داند.
فیلم؛ اثر تصویری داستانی یا مستند.
اکنون؛ همین لحظه یا بازهٔ زمانی بسیار نزدیک به حال.

items.meaningShownByHtml: داستان؛ روایت پیوسته‌ای از رخدادها و شخصیت‌ها.
معمولاً؛ برای کاری که در بیشتر مواقع یا طبق عادت رخ می‌دهد.
آخر هفته؛ روزهای پایانی هفته که معمولاً زمان استراحت یا فعالیت‌های شخصی است.
کار؛ فعالیت یا وظیفه‌ای که برای هدف مشخص انجام می‌شود.
